title: docs(adr): ADR-0087's artifact window names its third disjunct — a first-release-of-a-major floor replays the major step ('converted-major-step', 58f5c90999) (#23038)
body:
Fixes #23038
Clause-②: no

One dated amendment note in `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md`, in the shape `4cc5bcd858` (#20797) used for the #20390 note. Tier H (`docs/adr/**`), so this PR stays a draft for the maintainer's review. Nothing here publishes: `skip-changeset`.

## What changed

All three edits are in the one ADR file. No recorded text is rewritten.

- **Status line.** One more `**Amended**` entry (2026-10-13). It names the third disjunct, the producer `58f5c90999` and the verdict `'converted-major-step'`, and points at the new note. `4cc5bcd858` added a status-line entry for its note, so this one does too (H3).
- **The amendment note**, placed under the 2026-09-13 addendum's window bullet, right after the 2026-09-30 note. It records:
  - **The third disjunct.** The door replays E when the floor is below the runtime label, OR the floor is at or below `E.retiredAfter`, OR (the floor is `M.0.0` AND `E.toMajor` is M). A first-release floor at or above the runtime label replays every retired entry of the conversion step into M. Default flips are still refused by id first. The verdict is `'converted-major-step'`. Symbol anchor: `artifact-forward-conversion.ts#idsTheFloorPostdates`.
  - **Why.** During M's prerelease the label still names the last M-1 release, so every prerelease stamp sits below `M.0.0`. The per-entry half therefore read a `^18` artifact built before a prerelease retirement as `'authored-current'`.
  - **Why the replay is safe.** A conversion rewrites only the shape it recognizes.
  - **The M2 caveat**, worded as in the module docblock. It is anchored to `#DEFAULT_FLIPS_NOT_REPLAYED_HERE`.
  - **One clause aligning `retiredAfter`** with #23042's landed rule (H2, below).
  - **A pointer to the annotation** on the "within-line retirements" sentence.
- **The addendum's closing sentence** ("this window is for within-line retirements (17.1 → 17.2) …") is annotated, not rewritten, as triage `6124857034` directed. A dated `Annotated (2026-10-13)` blockquote follows it. It says the window also serves a prerelease-major floor (`^18` on a runtime labelled from 17.7.0 through 18.0.0; from 18.0.1 on, the label half replays the whole chain for it). It also says the handshake still answers first, because the protocol constant moves to M when M's prerelease opens.

Diff: 1 file, +42 / −1 (the −1 is the status line, which is extended, not reworded). The ADR goes from 1218 to 1259 lines.

## Checked before editing: the premise holds (H1), at `02bec6ca8`

- I ran the card's re-check on `origin/main`. The ADR has the `floor`-at-or-below-`E.retiredAfter` disjunct once, in the 2026-09-30 note, and "within-line retirements" once, in the closing sentence. The module has `firstReleaseOfMajor` in `idsTheFloorPostdates` and `'converted-major-step'` in the verdict union, the verdict assignment and the module docblock.
- `idsTheFloorPostdates` reads `DEFAULT_FLIPS_NOT_REPLAYED_HERE` first. It then opens a retired entry in one of two ways: `retiredAfter` is at or above the floor (the per-entry half), or `floor` is `M.0.0` and `conversion.toMajor === floor[0]` (the major-step half). Any `majorStep` entry gives the verdict `'converted-major-step'`.
- The module docblock already states the third disjunct and the M2 caveat, and the ADR names that docblock as the rule's authority.
- On this tree `PROTOCOL_VERSION` is `'18.0.0'` while `packages/spec/package.json` is `17.7.0`. This is the label/protocol split the annotation's handshake sentence relies on.

## H2: does #23042's landed rule leave ADR-0087's `retiredAfter` sentence true?

My reading differs from the dispatch's. The dispatch read "narrowed, not contradicted". I read that the sentence no longer holds as written under pre mode, so the note carries one aligning clause.

- The 2026-09-30 note defines `retiredAfter` as "the last published `@objectstack/spec` whose authoring surface still accepted the old shape".
- After `719183f50` (PR #23130), `RetiredConversionState.retiredAfter`'s TSDoc reads "… as a stable `x.y.z`". Under a prerelease label it is "the newest published stable release … never the label (not a stable `x.y.z`) and never `x.y.z`". The census test's docblock says "the census holds stable releases only".
- Prerelease tarballs are a real published category for this package. `npm view @objectstack/spec versions` lists 9 of them: `16.0.0-rc.0`–`rc.1` and `17.0.0-rc.0`–`rc.6`. `.changeset/pre.json` is `{"mode":"pre","tag":"next"}`, so `18.0.0-next.N` tarballs are next.
- Suppose a retirement lands after the first `18.0.0-next.N` publish. The ADR's sentence, read literally, then names that prerelease tarball. The landed rule names `17.7.0`. Those are two different values, and the prerelease one does not even type-check against `${number}.${number}.${number}`.
- The added clause: "The `retiredAfter` the note above defines is a stable `x.y.z`: under a prerelease label (Changesets pre mode) it is the newest published stable release, never a prerelease tarball (#23042, landed as `719183f50`, PR #23130)." It is in the same note. The 2026-09-30 text itself is untouched.
- If the maintainer reads the 2026-09-30 sentence as already meaning stable releases only, the clause is redundant but true. Dropping it is a one-sentence edit at review.

## H4: anchors

`scripts/adr-anchors/*.json` maps code files to ADR ids. It cites no ADR line ranges, so the insertion moves no anchor. `pnpm check:adr-anchors` exited 0. The note uses no `path:NNN` line anchors. Its two `path#Symbol` anchors resolve under `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, which reported 2321 anchors resolving and 0 line anchors.

## Acceptance notes

- H2's conclusion (above) adds one clause beyond the card's four named items. The dispatch authorized exactly that clause if the sentence measured untrue, in this same note and nowhere else.
- The module docblock of `artifact-forward-conversion.ts` still says "within-line retirements (17.1 → 17.2) are exactly the case that created this module" in its full-`x.y.z` paragraph. That sentence is about which comparison the module uses, so it remains true, and code is outside this card's surface. I noted it and did not edit it.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**
- ADR-0087 只加了一条带日期的修订注。位置在 2026-09-13 附录的窗口条目下,紧跟 2026-09-30 那条注之后。注里写明窗口的第三个析取:floor 是某大版本首发 `M.0.0` 且不低于运行时标签时,重放第 M 步的全部退役条目(默认翻转仍按 id 先拒),verdict 为 `'converted-major-step'`,出处是 `58f5c90999`。注里还写了 M2 告诫。
- 状态行加了一项 Amended。
- 附录结尾「within-line retirements」那句保持原文,只在其后加了一段带日期的注释。

**为什么改**
- 代码自 `58f5c90999` 起已按三个析取运行,ADR 的文字仍只写两个。读 ADR 判断「构件的退役条目何时重放」的人和 agent 会读到过窄的规则。
- 另有一处:#23042 落地后,`retiredAfter` 只取稳定版。ADR 原句没有说「稳定」,在 pre 模式下字面可读成预发布 tarball。注里加了一个分句对齐,原句未动。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
- 纯文档,不发布任何包,不影响运行时。回滚方式是 revert 本 PR 的单个提交。
- 对齐 `retiredAfter` 的那一分句是本次实测后加的(派发令授权「不成立才加」)。如果你认为原句本就只指稳定版,可在评审中要求删去这一句。

**席位意见**


**你要做的**
- 审阅 ADR-0087 的三处改动(Tier H),同意则给 APPROVED review。
- 如果希望删去 `retiredAfter` 对齐分句,或调整「within-line」注释的措辞,请在评审中写明。
